notes: Setup durations: submodule init 45s, npm ci 10s, reference:build 178s, baseline typecheck+lint+boundaries+unit 146s.

Deviation from the spec wording 'dbl/dblp input is refused': packed dbl input is refused by the chain's s64p rule before output, as the spec intends. Explicit planar double (aformat=f=dblp,channelmap=...) is not refused: native keeps dblp there and only copies, our output matches native byte for byte (2 differential comparisons), and the descriptor cannot refuse dblp before output because constraint() does not see the sample format.

Native exit status is 0 for map=0 on stereo, 0|0 on mono, 0|1 on three channels, FL-FC|FR-FL on stereo, f64 input and non-default masks (native converts implicitly or runs through s64p); we refuse all of them before opening output.
Error messages for native init/config failures reuse native's wording; the input-channel message capitalises 'Input' because it is the first word of our diagnostic.
No shared edit beyond the registry line was needed.
